newsitem.title: USA: Dole makes gaffe in San Diego.
newsitem.headline: Dole makes gaffe in San Diego.

text.p: Returning to the site where he won the Republican presidential nomination in August, Bob Dole on Monday confused this California city near the Mexican border with the famous city by the bay 500 miles (800 km) to the north.
"We're very honoured to be back in San Francisco," Dole told a waterfront rally on his arrival in San Diego, where he will face President Bill Clinton in the second presidential debate on Wednesday.
"We're here for a great convention," he said, then catching himself, added, "We had a great convention, yeah, San Diego, sure. We're back here again today."
The crowd muttered audibly at Dole's miscue.
Then Dole got back into the mood of the campaign, saying, "San Diego is where it started and we're on the move and we're going to carry the great state of California."
On a California stop earlier in the campaign, Dole referred to the "Brooklyn Dodgers" baseball team, long gone from that New York borough to Los Angeles and renamed the Los Angeles Dodgers.
